title: Every layer asks for the same key
description: Archives, loose files, scripts and the renderer each receive paths spelled their own way. Normalizing them all the same way is what lets a lookup in one find what another stored.

nodes.title: Any spelling
nodes.detail: Textures\Tx_Wood.DDS from a plugin, textures/tx_wood.dds from an archive, //TEXTURES/tx_wood.dds from a script.

nodes.title: dream-path
nodes.detail: Backslashes to slashes, ASCII to lowercase, repeated and leading separators gone. Every other byte kept.

nodes.title: One key
nodes.detail: textures/tx_wood.dds: the same bytes wherever the lookup happens, stored once as a NormalizedPath.

nodes.title: Archives and the VFS
nodes.detail: dream_archive and vfstool index entries by the normalized key.

nodes.title: Luau scripts
nodes.detail: require("@dream/path") gives scripts the same rules, byte for byte.
